name: Junie
desc: JetBrains' coding agent, BYOK with zero markup
desc_zh: JetBrains 自带的编码 Agent，可自带模型 Key
solves: It writes the plan, the design and the delivery stages before touching code, and you can steer it mid-task. Usage runs on AI Credits, not on unlimited time.
solves_zh: 改代码之前先写需求、设计和交付步骤，中途还能随时纠偏。用量按 AI Credits 计，不是按无限时长。
best_for: A team already on IntelliJ or PyCharm, where a second editor means a second set of habits.
best_for_zh: 当团队本来就在 IntelliJ 或 PyCharm 上，换编辑器等于重学一套习惯。
notes: The agent for teams already paying JetBrains — no second editor, no second subscription, and a free AI tier since 2025.1. 来源：https://blog.jetbrains.com/pycharm/2025/04/pycharm-2025-1/
